lines.sentence: Straeon himself woke a few hours later, in the edges of light, as he noticed the cleared battlefield. While there were certainly marks left behind, his own corpse was not one of them luckily.

However, it certainly felt close. Looking down, he couldn’t miss the wrapped wounds across his body, though whatever blood there was had stopped, a method of cauterization being applied. Someone provided him with care, and it likely wasn’t his assailants…
As he finally entered the town, the wind that blew through was the loudest noise he could hear. No joy, no song or tale. Not a person in sight. He stayed the night, only out of a need for a place.
Whatever happened here, there was no longer a story to tell.
